subGoals.rule: The status rule has one owner (guests); table reservations reach it only through the owner's published interface and never re-implement it (Fowler P3; Evans bounded context).
Completing (or booking) a reservation changes no guest: the guest's visits follow from a stored event delivered to the owning context (Vernon P4, eventual consistency outside the boundary).

plantedDebt.what: imports guests' GuestRepository and GuestId from its domain (cross-context internal import)

precedent: both: a clean published interface (guests index.ts, GuestProfile contract, reservations acl) and a stored-event reaction (ReservationCompleted delivered by the relay to the thank-you message), and a trap-shaped one (ConfirmationNote reads guests through guests' domain repository).
